cards.name: Bevel & Emboss
cards.summary: Gives the layer's shape a lit, raised 3D edge: a highlight on the side facing the light and a shadow on the far side, placed inside the edge (Inner Bevel), outside it (Outer Bevel, the scripted default), on both sides (Emboss), pressed into the surface (Pillow Emboss) or on a Stroke effect (Stroke Emboss). Technique sets soft rounded versus hard chiselled facets; the Contour and Texture sub-panels reshape the profile and bump-map a pattern into it.
use_for: 3D-looking headline or logo type for posters, thumbnails and title cards
raised buttons, badges and UI chips
chiselled metal, stone or wood lettering (Chisel Hard plus a gloss contour)
letterpress / debossed look (Pillow Emboss or Direction Down)
embossed paper, leather or wax-seal stamp with Apply Texture
avoid: high Size and Depth with the soft Smooth technique gives the dated 2000s web-button look; keep it subtle for modern work
the default highlight is white in Screen mode, so it disappears on white or very light fills: give the face some tone (Color / Gradient Overlay) or use a coloured highlight

Outer Bevel and Emboss draw part of the bevel on the pixels around the layer, so in the default modes the Screen highlight vanishes on a white background and the Multiply shadow vanishes on a black one
Size larger than about a third of the stroke width rounds thin type into blobs
Use Global Light on ties the angle to the document's Global Light, so changing it here moves every other effect that shares it; turn it off (useGlobalAngle false) for a one-off angle

Contour (mappingShape), Texture (pattern) and their sub-keys were only declared in the terminology, not read back by the harvest probe, so scripting them is untested: set them in the dialog or record them first
a real 3D extrusion with sides needs Illustrator 3D and Materials or a 3D app, not a bevel

params.name: bevelStyle
params.does: where the bevel sits: outside the edge, inside it, both (Emboss), pressed in (Pillow Emboss) or on the Stroke effect (Stroke Emboss, needs a Stroke)
params.typical: innerBevel for type and buttons; pillowEmboss for letterpress; scripted default outerBevel

params.name: bevelTechnique
params.does: facet shape: Smooth (soft rounded), Chisel Hard (crisp flat facets), Chisel Soft (rougher chisel that keeps detail)
params.typical: softMatte (default) for plastic / gel; preciseMatte for metal, stone, logos

params.name: strengthRatio
params.does: Depth: contrast of the shading, 1-1000 %

params.name: blur
params.does: Size: how wide the bevel is, 0-250 px
params.typical: 7 (default); 5-15 for headline type, larger only for big shapes

params.name: bevelDirection
params.does: Up (in, raised) or Down (stampOut, pressed in): swaps highlight and shadow

params.name: softness
params.does: Soften: blurs the shading facets, 0-16 px

params.name: useGlobalAngle
params.does: true shares the document's Global Light angle with other effects
params.typical: true; false for a one-off light direction

params.name: localLightingAngle
params.does: light direction, -180..180 degrees

params.name: localLightingAltitude
params.does: light height, 0-90 degrees: low = long shading, high = flatter with highlight spreading over the face

params.name: highlightMode
params.does: blend mode of the lit side

params.name: highlightColor
params.does: colour of the lit side

params.name: highlightOpacity
params.does: strength of the lit side, 0-100 %

params.name: shadowMode
params.does: blend mode of the shaded side

params.name: shadowColor
params.does: colour of the shaded side
params.typical: #000000; a dark shade of the fill colour looks richer

params.name: shadowOpacity
params.does: strength of the shaded side, 0-100 %

params.name: transferSpec
params.does: Gloss Contour curve (a shapeCurveType by name, read back as 'Linear'); Ring / Cone style curves give a metallic, multi-band shine. The terminology also declares a separate 'Gloss Curve' key (transparencyShape) that was not read back, so script the read-back transferSpec
params.typical: Linear; curves from Default Contours.shc for chrome

params.name: antialiasGloss
params.does: smooths a jagged gloss contour

params.name: useShape
params.does: Apply Shape: turns on the Contour sub-panel (mappingShape, inputRange) that reshapes the bevel profile
params.typical: false; true for rounded or ridged edges

params.name: useTexture
params.does: Apply Texture: bump-maps a pattern into the bevel (pattern, scale, textureDepth, invertTexture, align)
params.typical: false; true for embossed paper / leather

cards.name: Color Overlay
cards.summary: Fills every visible pixel of the layer with one flat colour at the chosen blend mode and opacity, keeping the layer's shape and transparency; the original pixels stay underneath and return when the effect is switched off. Several Color Overlays can be stacked on one layer (scripted as solidFillMulti).
use_for: recolour a logo, icon or text layer to a brand colour without touching its pixels
turn a cut-out into a flat silhouette (black or white overlay)
tint a photo layer with Multiply, Color or Soft Light mode
quick colour variants of the same artwork
one-colour versions of a placed logo for watermarks
avoid: in Normal mode all internal detail becomes one flat colour; use Color or Multiply mode, or a clipped Hue/Saturation layer, when shading must survive
it sits above Gradient and Pattern Overlay in the effect order, so at 100 % Normal it hides them
for a plain text colour change just set the text colour
not available on the locked Background layer: convert it to a normal layer first

cards.name: Drop Shadow
cards.summary: Casts a shadow of the layer's shape behind it, offset by Distance away from the light angle; Size blurs the shadow edge and Spread hardens it, from a soft floating shadow to a solid offset copy. Several can be stacked (dropShadowMulti).
use_for: lift headline type off a busy photo for legibility
soft contact shadow under a product cut-out
hard offset shadow for retro / pop typography (Spread 100, Size 0)
elevation on cards, buttons and UI mockups
sticker / collage look on cut-outs
avoid: dark, wide, fully opaque shadows look dated: keep opacity around 30-60 % and tint the colour from the background
it follows the layer's transparency only, so an uncut rectangular photo gets a rectangular shadow
a cast shadow lying on the floor needs Layer > Layer Style > Create Layer plus a transform, or a painted shadow
Use Global Light on ties the angle to the document's Global Light, so changing it here moves every other effect that shares it; turn it off (useGlobalAngle false) for a one-off angle
with layer knocks out (layerConceals) on, lowering the layer's Fill does not reveal the shadow under it; turn it off for shadows behind semi-transparent glass

cards.name: Gradient Overlay
cards.summary: Paints a gradient across the layer's visible pixels, clipped to its shape, as Linear, Radial, Angle, Reflected, Diamond or Shape Burst (which follows the shape's own outline inward), with angle, scale, offset, blend mode and interpolation method; the layer's pixels stay underneath and the gradient stays editable. The scripted default gradient runs black to white. Several can be stacked (gradientFillMulti).
use_for: gradient-filled headline or logo type (sunset, chrome, brand two-tone)
light falloff over a flat shape or button (black-to-white in Overlay / Soft Light at low opacity)
colour-graded tint on a photo layer with Color, Overlay or Soft Light mode
editable UI buttons and banners
Shape Burst for an inline glow that follows lettering
avoid: Align With Layer off measures the gradient against the whole canvas, so each layer shows a different slice; keep it on for per-layer gradients
8-bit gradients over large smooth areas band: turn on Dither or work in 16-bit
it sits under Color Overlay in the effect order, so a 100 % Color Overlay hides it
a custom gradient cannot be named by preset alone in a script: build the colour-stop and transparency lists as in the scripting example

cards.name: Inner Glow
cards.summary: Adds a glow inside the layer's edges, fading inward from the edge (Source Edge) or outward from the centre (Source Center), in a solid colour or gradient; Size sets how far it reaches, Choke hardens it, and Range, Jitter and the Contour curve shape the falloff. It has no angle or offset.
use_for: neon-tube or backlit lettering (with Outer Glow)
soft rim light on buttons, icons and badges
glassy / gel UI look
dark inner vignette edge on a shape (dark colour, Multiply)
Center source for a hot-core glow in fire or energy text
avoid: the default white Screen glow is invisible on white or very light fills: pick a colour that contrasts with the fill
Size above half the stroke width floods thin type with colour; lower Size or use Precise
for a shadow cast inward from one side use Inner Shadow (Inner Glow has no angle or distance)
Choke's harvest range probe was inconclusive (every probe read back 100), so keep it to the dialog's 0-100

cards.name: Outer Glow

use_for: neon-sign lettering and glowing UI on dark backgrounds

avoid: the default white Screen glow vanishes on light backgrounds; use Normal, or Multiply with a dark colour
large Size with no Spread looks smudgy rather than glowing; for neon raise Spread and add an Inner Glow
a directional shadow is Drop Shadow's job (Outer Glow has no angle)

use_for: textured type and logos (wood, denim, paper, halftone dots) in Multiply or Overlay

scaling above 100 % softens bitmap patterns; make a larger pattern instead

cards.name: Satin
cards.summary: Adds soft, wavy interior shading that follows the shape, built from blurred copies of the layer's own silhouette offset in opposite directions along Angle by Distance; the bands read as a satin, liquid or polished-metal sheen. Size softens the bands, Invert flips light and dark areas, and the Contour curve reshapes them.
use_for: chrome, gold or polished-metal type (with Bevel & Emboss and a Gradient Overlay)
satin ribbon, silk or liquid sheen on shapes
subtle interior shading that gives flat lettering volume
glossy plastic or glass logo finishes
avoid: the result depends on the shape: the same settings look very different on thin and heavy letters, so preview on the real artwork
a large Distance on small type fills the letters with one dark blob; scale Distance and Size with the stroke width
for a predictable directional sheen a Gradient Overlay is easier to control
the default black Multiply only darkens; for a light sheen use a light colour in Screen
